name: eval-harness
title: eval-harness
description: Eval-driven development for AI agent work: capability and regression evals defined before coding, code/model/rule/human graders, and pass@k / pass^k reliability tracking. Vendored as-is from ECC, where it is framed for Claude Code sessions; the methodology is harness-agnostic.
why: The collection had zero eval methodology for prompt or agent changes — the exact gap behind flagship-validation failures in the owner's bots, where a change ships on vibes instead of a regression suite.
